method: v7: 60% goals_cosine (hierarchy-aware) + 25% KSE geo + 15% KSE mss_network
warning: Unverified hypotheses unless known=true. Combined score is not a pure strategy match — use track / slice files. suggested_theme / suggested_form are IMC-package hypotheses, not registry facts.

tracks.thematic: goals_cosine >= p90 (0.07) and geo_score <= 0.35 — cold-start vision partners
tracks.operational: geo_score >= 0.85 and not thematic — convenient service co-sharers; slice ranked by operational_score (geo + fiscal_similarity + dream_overlap) when available

operationalBoost.note: Extra fields on edges; v7 combined-score weights unchanged from v6

mssSuggest.note: Rule-based theme + legal-form package (mss_suggest.py); does not change score; never sets known=true

operational.note: Neighbours not already linked in the KSE МСС network
